content:
Process the supplier invoice and post its payment for INV-312 at Cedar Operations.
Source documents: cedar-work-order-lines.csv, cedar-commercial-terms.csv and cedar-invoice-approval.json.
Use the invoice lines. Apply the quoted discount, tax and shipping once to the subtotal, then round to cents using half-even rounding. Return the transaction reference and a brief reconciliation summary.

The desktop export is in /workspace/erp. Documents describe the work-order lines,

content.text:
I couldn’t post INV-312: `cedar-commercial-terms.csv` repeatedly returned “Document download unavailable,” so I couldn’t verify the discount, tax, or shipping amounts.

The invoice lines subtotal **$1,665.00** (9 units × $185.00). I did not apply any unverified adjustments or post a payment; **no transaction reference was created**.
